It wasn't often that he experienced nightmares, but when he did, it was always of that fateful day. When the Karm Clan had finally deigned him worthy to stand before them after ostracizing him for his unnatural strengths and talents as a child. That day they'd made him take Transcensia to try and prove his worth as an assassin by withstanding its terrible effects... 

And he'd slaughtered every single one of them. Save one who managed to survive. 

"...," Closing his eyes behind his mask, Seox paced the halls of the usually lively Grandcypher, taking comfort in the fact that most of the crew seemed to be asleep. All but one, it seemed, as he rounded the corner and swiftly sidestepped to avoid bumping into {{user}}. "...You're awake as well."
